observedTests.name: Actual installed app
observedTests.observed: Two visible launches passed original 15-event and custom four-event flows, exact UTC windows, rejected-import preservation, retained IndexedDB, JSON and CSV, cancel and no-overwrite, closed bridge refusals and a real export through repeated Quit. Both processes exited zero without renderer errors.

observedTests.name: Original source and browser gates
observedTests.observed: 100 scoped source tests passed at 97.90% coverage; 26 native helper cases passed at 99.27% lines and 95.97% branches over five helpers. Six ZIP controls and original three-engine browser and Lighthouse gates passed; six existing browser-specific skips remain explicit.

observedTests.name: Distribution and security
observedTests.observed: Five independently downloaded release files matched provider hashes. All 89 installed files stayed unchanged. All three exact-source main workflows and three actual raw CodeQL categories passed with no findings or open alerts before publication.

visualReview.scope: All four final pages individually inspected at original resolution; exact installed synthetic screenshots and immutable code; no ordinary user data.
